additional_info.subject: ID0480246-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T9 4002921972] Charger Out of service CRM:03209000237
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0480246
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Chrono Energie
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asse
t: Y2/T9 4002921972
Charger ID / Serial No.: eF4jQy
Charger address/functional location: Switserland
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Cable temp sensor
Following the report of the client, we see that outlet 1 is unavailable because of the cable temp sensor. See the logs:
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure 1kOhm until you reach the KF12/ KF14
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm to the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0480246-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T9 4002921972] Charger Out of service CRM:03209000237
additional_info.body:
Hello
I want to share the results of our intervention today:
we went on site today and checked everything, we measured P1 to P2 and N1 to N2 as well as P1’ to P2’ and N1’ to N2’ from DC1, as well as DC2; everything is 1kOhm. It was not possible to observe any issue, afterwards the measured the Cables from XF410/XD412 to KF11/12/14, everything is good, no lose connection, no broken cable, nothing. It was not possible during our on-site check to identify any issue.
Whats your recommandation?
I would suggest closing the ticket for the moment because everything was checked and no issue was observed.
